model: EmbeddingGemma 2 cut to its first 4 layers, distilled 10 epochs onto EG2 q4 query vectors, then fine-tuned 1 epoch on Bluesky alt text (experiments#103, eg2-layer-student run C, 2026-10-22)
space: EG2 q4 (onnx-community/embeddinggemma-2-ONNX model_q4.onnx) query vectors, 768-d; documents stay EG2
tokenize: tokenizer.json (32K cut, BPE-closed, byte fallback) on prompt + text, including its special-token post-processing (BOS); truncate ids to max_tokens

files.model_t3w.onnx: q4 layers + 3-bit table, standard-op unpack; onnxruntime-web wasm + WebGPU and engine.js

text_to_image_heldout.note: 1,035 alt-text queries whose images were held out of training (sha1(cid) % 5 == 0), over this page's 16,878-image index
